svg.title: The customer who vanished from your revenue report: LEFT JOIN and the NULL that sums to nothing
svg.desc: A database report table whose fourth customer row is an empty warm-outlined hole with a NULL circle-and-slash where its revenue should be, one ghost row peeling away to the right. Trace Bloom generative banner for “The customer who vanished from your revenue report: LEFT JOIN and the NULL that sums to nothing”. A manhattan lattice probed by 3 emitters; interference blooms mark where the wavefronts meet. Seed 1046175516.
